name: relations_and_functions
title: Chapter 1: Relations and Functions
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 1 — Relations and Functions. Covers types of relations (empty, universal, reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence relations and equivalence classes), types of functions (one-one/injective, onto/surjective, bijective), composition of functions and invertible functions, with all examples and exercises.

name: inverse_trigonometric_functions
title: Chapter 2: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 2 — Inverse Trigonometric Functions. Covers definitions, restricted domains and ranges (principal value branches) of sin-inverse, cos-inverse, tan-inverse, cot-inverse, sec-inverse and cosec-inverse, their graphs, and the standard identities and properties, with all examples and exercises.

name: matrices
title: Chapter 3: Matrices
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 3 — Matrices. Covers order and types of matrices, equality, addition, scalar multiplication and matrix multiplication, transpose, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices, elementary row/column operations and the inverse of a matrix by elementary operations, with all examples and exercises.

name: determinants
title: Chapter 4: Determinants
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 4 — Determinants. Covers determinant of a square matrix and its properties, area of a triangle, minors and cofactors, adjoint and inverse of a matrix, and applications to solving systems of linear equations (consistency, Cramer-style matrix method), with all examples and exercises.

name: continuity_and_differentiability
title: Chapter 5: Continuity and Differentiability
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 5 — Continuity and Differentiability. Covers continuity, algebra of continuous functions, differentiability, the chain rule, derivatives of implicit, inverse trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions, logarithmic differentiation, derivatives in parametric form, second-order derivatives, and the Mean Value Theorems, with all examples and exercises.

name: application_of_derivatives
title: Chapter 6: Application of Derivatives
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 6 — Application of Derivatives. Covers rate of change of quantities, increasing and decreasing functions, tangents and normals, approximations, maxima and minima, and optimisation problems, with all examples and exercises.

name: proofs_in_mathematics
title: Appendix 1: Proofs in Mathematics
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Appendix 1 — Proofs in Mathematics. Covers mathematical statements, methods of proof (direct proof, proof by contrapositive, proof by contradiction) and the use of counterexamples, with worked examples.

name: mathematical_modelling
title: Appendix 2: Mathematical Modelling
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Appendix 2 — Mathematical Modelling. Covers the purpose of mathematical modelling and model building for real-life problems using matrices, calculus and linear programming, with examples and exercises.

name: answers_volume_1
title: Answers (Volume 1 — Chapters 1 to 6)
description: Answer key for the exercises of CBSE Class 12 Maths Volume 1 (Chapters 1-6: Relations and Functions, Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Matrices, Determinants, Continuity and Differentiability, Application of Derivatives). Use to look up final answers to exercise questions from Volume 1.

name: preliminary_pages_volume_1
title: Preliminary Pages (Volume 1)
description: Preliminary pages for CBSE Class 12 Maths Volume 1. Includes the front matter, publication details, preface, rationalisation note, course structure and textbook overview for Part I.

name: integrals
title: Chapter 7: Integrals
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 7 — Integrals. Covers integration as inverse differentiation, methods of integration, integrals of special functions, partial fractions, integration by parts, definite integrals and their properties, with all examples and exercises.

name: application_of_integrals
title: Chapter 8: Application of Integrals
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 8 — Application of Integrals. Covers area under simple curves and area between two curves using definite integrals, with all examples and exercises.

name: differential_equations
title: Chapter 9: Differential Equations
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 9 — Differential Equations. Covers order and degree of a differential equation, general and particular solutions, formation of differential equations, and methods of solving them (variables separable, homogeneous, and linear differential equations), with all examples and exercises.

name: vector_algebra
title: Chapter 10: Vector Algebra
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 10 — Vector Algebra. Covers vectors and scalars, types of vectors, addition of vectors, components and direction cosines, multiplication of a vector by a scalar, position vectors, and the scalar (dot) product, vector (cross) product and projections, with all examples and exercises.

name: three_dimensional_geometry
title: Chapter 11: Three Dimensional Geometry
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 11 — Three Dimensional Geometry. Covers direction cosines and direction ratios of a line, the vector and Cartesian equations of a line in space, and the angle between two lines, with all examples and exercises.

name: linear_programming
title: Chapter 12: Linear Programming
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 12 — Linear Programming. Covers linear programming problems, mathematical formulation, constraints, feasible regions, objective functions and graphical solution methods, with all examples and exercises.

name: probability
title: Chapter 13: Probability
description: Full text of CBSE Class 12 Maths Chapter 13 — Probability. Covers conditional probability, multiplication theorem, independent events, Bayes' theorem, random variables, probability distributions, mean and variance, and binomial distribution, with all examples and exercises.

name: answers_volume_2
title: Answers (Volume 2 — Chapters 7 to 13)
description: Answer key for the exercises of CBSE Class 12 Maths Volume 2 (Chapters 7-13: Integrals, Application of Integrals, Differential Equations, Vector Algebra, Three Dimensional Geometry, Linear Programming, Probability). Use to look up final answers to exercise questions from Volume 2.

name: preliminary_pages_volume_2
title: Preliminary Pages (Volume 2)
description: Preliminary pages for CBSE Class 12 Maths Volume 2. Includes the front matter, publication details, preface, rationalisation note, course structure and textbook overview for Part II.
